title: Blueprint project statistics
description: The JSON form of Informal.Stats.ProjectStats (src/VersoBlueprint/Stats/Data.lean), schema version 3. Paths are relative to the project root with '/' separators; lists have a fixed order; there is no version-control data. Optional values are present as null.

layout.description: Where the statistics looked: source directories that hold the project's modules, and library directories of the workspace's packages inside the project.

projectRoot.description: The project root relative to the working directory, when the Blueprint names one (the option verso.blueprint.projectRoot); null when it is the working directory.

modules.description: The project's modules in the checked environment, sorted by name.

declarations.description: Declarations of the project's modules by kind; declarations Lean generates (constructors, recursors, projections, equation lemmas, matchers, internal names) are not counted.

sources.description: Every .lean file under the project root outside hidden directories (such as .lake), sorted by path, and the sum of their lines.

status.description: imported: a module of the environment the site was generated from; compiled: not imported, but a library directory holds its .olean; notBuilt: neither.

leanProgress.description: The nodes by kind group: theorem-like nodes (theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries) and definitions.

chapters.description: Progress by chapter (the first directory of the nodes' page addresses), in order of first appearance. Empty until the site's pages are known.

graph.description: The size of the dependency graph; placeholders for unknown references are not nodes.

edges.description: Distinct dependent-dependency pairs on either axis.

byKind.description: [kind, count] pairs in the order definition, proposition, lemma, theorem, corollary; kinds without nodes are left out.

trust.description: What the proofs rest on beyond Lean's standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), node by node. Lists are sorted by label, then declaration.

challenges.description: The project's headline results: one for each of its Comparator challenges (a folder Comparator/<Name>/ each), in the order of their names. Empty when the project has no Comparator challenge.

hasComparatorChallenge.description: Whether the project has a Comparator challenge: a folder Comparator/<Name>/ that follows the layout. Without one a page can say that a challenge would add a headline.

replay.description: The kernel replay made while the site was generated, of the Lean declarations the site reports on and every constant they depend on; null when the generator ran none. A page says "proved" only with an accepted replay that covers the declarations concerned.

outcome.description: accepted: both checkers accepted the export, every declaration of declarations with every constant it depends on. rejected: a checker rejected it and neither accepted it (message, checkers). disagreed: one accepted and the other rejected it. declined: a checker declined to check it and neither rejected it. noChecker: the project's toolchain ships no con-leche or no con-ron (message). timedOut: the replay was stopped at limitSeconds. overMemory: a process of the replay went over memoryLimit and was stopped. overExport: the export went over exportLimit and was not checked. failed: the replay could not run to a verdict (message). off: the replay was switched off.

checker.description: The checkers' names, for a sentence: con-leche and con-ron.

version.description: The Lean version of the toolchain the checkers ship with.

declarations.description: The declarations the replay covers: with accepted, each was exported with every constant it depends on and both checkers accepted the export; otherwise the declarations that were to be checked. In the order of Lean's Name.quickLt.

notCovered.description: Declarations the replay was asked for and does not cover, each with the reason.

axioms.description: Declarations the replay was asked for that rest on an axiom outside Lean's standard three, with those axioms, as found by walking the terms of the loaded modules. They are not exported and not checked: both checkers decline an export that uses such an axiom.

constants.description: The number of constants in the export.

origins.description: Where the exported constants come from: the project, each dependency, Lean's own library.

name.description: The first component of the modules' names; for the project and for Lean's own library, every such component joined by commas.

recorded.description: With accepted: both checkers accepted an identical export in an earlier run and were not run again (always false with reproducible).

message.description: With rejected, disagreed, declined or failed: what the checker, or the generator, said. With overMemory: what went over the limit. With noChecker: what the toolchain lacks.

memoryLimit.description: With overMemory: the memory limit of the process, in bytes.

exportLimit.description: With overExport: the size limit of the export, in bytes.

records.description: The declaration records of the export (def, thm, opaque, axiom, inductive, quot), as the generator counted them in the file.

reproducible.description: The site is built to be reproducible: recorded is false, and the checkers carry no time, memory or count of an acceptance.

checkers.description: What each checker answered, in the order they ran (con-leche, then con-ron); empty when none ran.

name.description: The program's name: con-leche or con-ron.

version.description: The Lean version of the toolchain the program ships with.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the program's file, in hexadecimal.

answer.description: Its answer by exit status first and words second: accepted (status 0, its line accepted N declarations and N at least records), rejected (status 1 with its words of rejection), declined (status 2), error (status 1 with an uncaught exception), noAnswer (anything else, also status 0 with too short a count), timedOut, overMemory, notStarted.

declarations.description: The declaration records it said it accepted, or checked before it declined.

message.description: What it said, when it did not accept.

ms.description: How long it ran, in milliseconds; null in a reproducible build.

peakBytes.description: The most memory it was seen to hold (sampled), in bytes; null when never read or in a reproducible build.

builtSources.description: What was known, when the site's data was captured, of the source text each project module whose declarations the nodes refer to, and each project module those import, directly or not, was compiled from: Lake's hash of that text (from Lake's build record, or of the module being elaborated), or why none is known. Empty for a site generated from compiled-code data.

hash.description: Lake's hash of the text, sixteen hexadecimal digits; null when none is known.

why.description: Why no hash is known; empty when one is.

sourceChanged.description: The project modules that are not known to match the build, sorted by name: those whose source text, as the site shows it, is not known to be the text their compiled module was compiled from, and those that import such a module, directly or not. No positive mark, success colour or complete count is shown for their declarations.

changed.description: true: the source differs from the one the build compiled; false: no build record says which source it was, or a project module it imports, directly or not, is not known to match the build (why, which then begins "it imports " and names that module).

claims.description: The author's claims about what Lean declarations state (informal-claims.json at the project root); null without the file. Author-supplied text: nothing compares it with the Lean statements.

source.description: The manuscript, or other source, the claims refer to.

claims.description: In the file's order, one per declaration.

reference.description: The result's own name in the source, such as "Theorem 2.2".

attestations.description: People who say they compared the claim with the Lean statement. A person's statement, not a check.

error.description: Why the file could not be read; claims is then empty.

correspondence.description: How a declaration of the challenge compares with the solution's declaration of the same name: the same (for a theorem the same statement, for anything else the same declaration including its value, and the same for every declaration of the challenge its statement uses), a definition hole whose value the solution supplies, differs, missing from the solution, or not compared (headline.unavailable says why).

headline.description: One Comparator challenge as lake comparator reads it, compared with its solution: the folder Comparator/<name>/ with Challenge.lean (module Comparator.<name>.Challenge), Solution.lean (module Comparator.<name>.Solution) and comparator.json (challenge_module, solution_module, theorem_names, permitted_axioms; optionally definition_names and external_kernels).

name.description: The challenge's name: its folder's name under Comparator/.

config.description: The challenge's comparator.json, relative to the project root.

permittedAxioms.description: The axioms the challenge permits, when it states them.

unavailable.description: Why no comparison could be made: comparator.json is invalid; the challenge's compiled module is missing, does not match its source (also by Lake's build record of it, or because a project module it imports changed since the build), is not known to come from its source (challengeProvenanceUnknown: no usable build record of it or of a project module it imports), or is unreadable; the environment of the site lacks the solution module or a module the challenge imports; the compiled modules could not be loaded for the kernel replay; a module the proof uses (the solution module, or a project module it imports, directly or not) changed since the build (solutionOutOfDate) or is not known to match it (solutionProvenanceUnknown), with the module and its file in unavailableDetail; the challenge or solution module has a compiled file in more than one directory of the search path (moduleAmbiguous). Null when the comparison was made.

unavailableDetail.description: The module, file or error message behind unavailable.

unjudged.description: Without theorem_names: theorems of the challenge module that carry no source position and that Lean did not generate on its own, each with the reason it is not judged.

theorems.description: The theorems judged (theorem_names, or every theorem of the challenge with a source position), in source order.

docstring.description: The challenge's docstring, as written without its delimiters.

statement.description: The statement as written in the challenge, from its keyword to the end of the signature; empty without the source.

differingDeclaration.description: When solution is differs: the first declaration found to differ, the theorem itself or a declaration of the challenge its statement uses.

difference.description: When solution is differs: how, in a few words. When it is notTheorem: what the challenge declares instead.

sorryFree.description: Whether the solution's declaration is free of sorry, directly or through what it uses; null when the solution has none.

axioms.description: The axioms the solution's declaration depends on: sorryAx first, then other axioms, compiled-code axioms, the standard three.

axiomsPermitted.description: Whether every axiom is in permittedAxioms; null without a list.

axiomsNotAllowed.description: The axioms the verdict does not allow, sorryAx aside: those outside permittedAxioms when the challenge states a list, else those outside Lean's standard three.

conditionsMet.description: What the compiled modules report: the same Lean statement as the challenge, without sorry and with axiomsNotAllowed empty. No kernel is run for it; a theorem is called proved only when replay is also accepted, covers the theorem and found no axiom under it that is not permitted.

node.description: The Blueprint node whose Lean declarations include the theorem.

definitions.description: The other declarations the challenge introduces, in source order.

name.description: A Lean name as Lean prints it, with « » around components that need them.

lineCounts.description: Physical lines: whitespace only (blank), comment text only (comment: line comments, nested block comments, docstrings) or anything else (code).

kindProgress.description: Nodes of one kind group. leanComplete: the node's Lean declarations, with everything they use, contain no sorry (nothing is said about axioms). leanCompleteWithDependencies: of those, the nodes whose dependencies in the graph are all Lean complete. informal: nodes that have an informal statement.

progress.description: Nodes by the dependency graph's fill status.

sourceChanged.description: Nodes whose Lean source is not known to be the text that was compiled (changed since the build, or no build record says which text it was): not complete, and shown with no verdict.

axioms.description: The axioms that put the declaration on this row.

identity.description: What the files at the project root say: the root package name in lake-manifest.json, the README's first heading and first prose paragraph (plain text), the license file with an SPDX guess (null: no license file), lean-toolchain and the locked packages in manifest order.

url.description: Without any user name or password.
